title: South Okanagan Desert Tour
includes: Binoculars, Spotting scope, Birding Field Guides, Plant Guides
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Okanagan Desert Tour is an unforgettable experience. Travel by foot through Canada's only desert in search of secretive and fascinating creatures found nowhere else in Canada.

The Okanagan Desert Tour showcases the unique, rare, and endangered places, plants, and animals of the Osoyoos area. You visit one of the four most endangered ecosystems in Canada, the region with the highest species diversity and some of the last remaining Sage and Antelope ecosystems in Canada. Minimum 2 people
